No external dependencies beyond pytest; no threads, network, filesystem, or clock usage.

UI / UX / Interaction Design draft: This project is headless and non-interactive. Main.py provides run_demo() that constructs a FakeTransferAdapter with mapping {"https://example.com/clip": (12,4)}, enqueues a single mp4 DownloadRequest, processes it synchronously, and returns a status dict. No printing, user input, GUI, filesystem, or network involvement. Tests access the canonical API only via the video_downloader package and run_demo() in Main.py.
User Stories: As a user, I want to queue multiple downloads and process them sequentially so I can manage tasks deterministically.
As a user, I want to cancel a pending download before it starts to avoid unnecessary work.
As a user, I want progress updates and a final status with total bytes and completion state.
As a user, I want filenames to be sanitized and made unique so saved outputs do not collide.
As a user, I want invalid URLs or formats to be rejected with explicit errors.
